from decimal import Decimal
import pytest
from ledger import total

def test_exact_decimal():
    assert total(["0.1", "0.2"]) == Decimal("0.3")
    assert isinstance(total(["1"]), Decimal)

def test_signed():
    assert total(["-12.50", "+3", "9.50"]) == Decimal("0")

def test_blank_ignored():
    assert total(["", "  ", "\t", "5"]) == Decimal("5")

def test_bad_value():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        total(["1", "abc"])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        total(["nan"])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        total(["inf"])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        total(["1", ""])
